notes: Subject-object insert. The prompts' facts are given; 'wrote only in Cornish' and 'never wrote a sonnet' are universal restrictions over author_of.

queries.not_checked: fol (temporal): a poem is written before its author's death (1561 vs the seventeenth century)

fol.notes: Years are Int. written_by is a function (RELATIONS.md: functional), the edited belief; the year a poem was written is occurred_in_year (ATTRIBUTES.md: a work written). The firm rule: a poem is written before (by the year of) its author's death. The seventeenth century is 1601 to 1700. 'Could it have been written in the seventeenth century?' is a consistency question (mode consistent).

written_before_death.says: A poem is written before its author dies.
written_before_death.z3: ForAll([w, p], Implies(written_by(w) == p, occurred_in_year(w) <= died_in_year(p)))
